ctx.x: Oh, they had a lotta dances but I don't remember 'em all. I couldn't keep up with all that stuff.

So, then, we run...we run the place a lo-o-o-ong time. We had all the bigshots from downtown comin' over there. We have a balcony full of white folks. They come to the Black and Tan...to hear The Singin' Bartender sing. I'd make money hand-over-fist...a lot of tips...put 'em all in a...I'd be in the...the band's in the balcony, and I'd get out behind the bar, go up the steps, an' Count Basie and them'd play for me.
